# Gitee

> Gitee is China's leading software development platform, providing developers with comprehensive DevOps services such as code hosting, collaborative development, continuous integration, and project management. Based on the Git version control system, it supports enterprise-level code management and team collaboration.

Gitee's main features include:

- **Code Hosting**: Distributed version control based on Git, also supports SVN, with both public and private repositories
- **Collaborative Development**: Pull Requests, Issue management, code review, project boards
- **Continuous Integration**: Gitee Go for automated build, test, and deployment
- **Project Management**: Agile tools, milestone management, task assignment
- **Enterprise Services**: Enterprise-level permission management, security auditing, data backup
- **Open Source Community**: Open source project hosting, community interaction, technical sharing

## Product Editions

### Gitee Community Edition
The free, open-source focused edition that serves as China's premier open source community platform:

- **Open Source Community Leadership**: Hosts millions of open source projects with active community engagement and technical sharing
- **Free Code Hosting**: Unlimited public repositories with basic collaboration features
- **Developer Ecosystem**: Rich plugin ecosystem, API integration, and developer tools
- **Community Features**: Issue tracking, Pull Requests, Wiki documentation, and project discussions
- **Learning Resources**: Comprehensive tutorials, documentation, and best practices for developers

### Gitee Professional Edition
[Gitee Professional Edition](https://gitee.com/professional.md): An all-in-one DevSecOps platform tailored for enterprises with private deployment capabilities:

- **Data Privacy & Security Compliance**: Private deployment with enterprise-grade access control and regulatory compliance
- **End-to-End DevSecOps Lifecycle**: Complete coverage from requirements to deployment with integrated security practices
- **Private AI Capabilities**: On-premises AI for code review, intelligent recommendations, and automated quality assurance
- **Quality Assurance**: Built-in industry-standard guidelines with automated scanning across 17+ programming languages
- **Enterprise Integration**: LDAP authentication, Jenkins, SonarQube, and extensive API ecosystem
- **Flexible Deployment**: Supports ARM processors, distributed architecture, and custom enterprise needs

### Gitee Enterprise Edition
[Gitee Enterprise Edition](https://gitee.com/enterprises.md): AI-Powered DevSecOps integrated platform for large-scale digital transformation:

- **AI Intelligence Empowerment**: Advanced AI for automatic defect detection, intelligent code reviews, test case generation, and predictive analytics
- **Full DevSecOps Lifecycle Coverage**: End-to-end platform covering project management, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and multi-cloud deployment
- **Security & Compliance Assurance**: Real-time code security scanning, vulnerability management, IP whitelisting, and comprehensive audit logs
- **Efficient Automation**: AI-driven workflow optimization, automated pipelines, and intelligent resource allocation
- **Industry-Proven Scale**: Trusted by 360,000+ enterprise customers across scientific research, finance, manufacturing, and healthcare
- **Scalable Infrastructure**: 99.99% uptime with automated backup, disaster recovery, and multi-cloud deployment capabilities

### Gitee Education Edition
[Gitee Education Edition](https://gitee.com/education.md): Empowering computer science education reform and "New Engineering" practices:

- **Class/Team Management**: Multi-role permissions, QR code invitations, and customizable teacher/assistant/student roles
- **Course Lifecycle Management**: One-click notifications, automated assignment grading, and comprehensive course management
- **Assignment Automation**: Support for text and code assignments with automated testing, plagiarism detection, and grading
- **Multi-scenario Support**: Covers teaching, training, research, graduation projects, and competitions
- **Flexible Deployment**: Available as SaaS or private deployment options
- **Wide Adoption**: Trusted by over 2,000 universities including Peking University, Tsinghua University, and more

## Recommended Projects && Groups
- [Recommended Open Source Projects](https://gitee.com/explore.md): Recommendations and discovery of popular open source projects
- [Recommended Open Source Projects](https://gitee.com/explore): Recommendations and discovery of popular open source projects

## API Documentation

- [Gitee API v5](https://gitee.com/api/v5/swagger): Complete REST API documentation for the community edition, including detailed descriptions and examples for all endpoints
- [Gitee API v8](https://gitee.com/api/v8/swagger): Complete REST API documentation for the enterprise edition, including detailed descriptions and examples for all endpoints
- [OAuth2 Authentication](https://gitee.com/api/v5/oauth_doc): OAuth2 authorization process and API usage instructions

## User Guides

- [Quick Start](https://help.gitee.com/questions/Git%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E5%B8%B8%E8%A7%81%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98): Beginner's guide for new users, including registration, repository creation, and basic operations
- [Git Tutorial](https://gitee.com/help/categories/43): Basic Git commands and workflows
- [Enterprise Features](https://gitee.com/enterprises): Introduction and usage of enterprise-level features
- [Enterprise Pricing](https://gitee.com/enterprises/price): Enterprise pricing and subscription plans
- [Professional Edition](https://gitee.com/professional): Introduction to Gitee Professional Edition

## Integration Tools

- [IDE Plugins](https://gitee.com/help/categories/53): Supports mainstream IDEs such as VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA
- [Jenkins Plugin](https://gitee.com/help/articles/4193): CI/CD integration jenkins plugin

## Optional

- [Help Center](https://gitee.com/help): Complete user documentation and FAQ
- [Community Forum](https://gitee.com/gitee-community): User communication and technical discussions
- [Open Source Project Search](https://so.gitee.com): Search for open source projects
- [Gitee Blog](https://blog.gitee.com): Official Gitee blog, technical sharing, and industry news
- [Gitee AI](https://moark.com): A MaaS platform for AI services, including serverless api, open source large language models, and other AI services

# Gitee

## Gitee Open Source Project Explorer

### Page Overview

The Gitee Open Source Project Explorer page (`/explore`) is the core entry point for discovering high-quality open source projects. It provides developers with functions for discovering, filtering, and exploring projects.

### Main Features

#### Project Discovery
- **Recommended Projects**: Algorithm-based recommendations of high-quality open source projects
- **Category Browsing**: Display projects by technical domain (Frontend, Backend, Mobile Development, Artificial Intelligence, etc.)
- **Language Filtering**: Filter projects by programming languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.)
- **License Filtering**: Filter projects by open source license type

#### Sorting Options
- **Recommended Order**: Smart recommendations based on project quality, activity, and influence
- **Latest Update**: Sort by most recent update time
- **Stars**: Sort by number of Stars

#### Filter Conditions
- **Project Categories**: Support filtering by primary and secondary categories
  - Frontend: Vue.js, React, Angular, etc.
  - Backend: Spring Boot, Django, Laravel, etc.
  - Mobile Development: Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native
  - Artificial Intelligence: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing
  - Databases: Projects related to MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
  - DevOps: CI/CD, monitoring, deployment tools
  - Blockchain: Cryptocurrency, Smart Contracts, DeFi
  - Game Development: Game engines and frameworks
  - Internet of Things: Embedded systems, sensors, smart hardware

- **Programming Languages**:
  - JavaScript, Java, Python, Go, C++, C#, PHP, TypeScript
  - Swift, Kotlin, Rust, Ruby, Scala, Dart, etc.

- **Open Source Licenses**:
  - MIT License, Apache License 2.0, GPL v3, BSD License
  - Creative Commons, Mozilla Public License, etc.

#### Featured Content

##### GVP (Gitee Valuable Projects)
- Officially certified high-quality open source projects by Gitee
- Strictly reviewed outstanding projects
- Representative projects from various technical fields

##### Trending Projects
- Real-time display of trending projects
- Based on metrics such as Star growth rate, Fork count, and participation
- Helps developers discover rising projects

##### Language Rankings
- Displays project count statistics by programming language
- Reflects developers' preferences in technology stacks
- Helps developers understand the tech ecosystem

#### Project Information Display

Each project entry includes:
- **Project Name & Description**: A brief and clear introduction
- **Author Info**: Creator or organization behind the project
- **Tech Tags**: Main programming languages used
- **Stats**: Star count, Fork count, Issue count
- **Update Time**: Time of the latest commit
- **License**: Type of open source license

#### Search Function
- Full-text search for project name, description, and tags
- Smart search suggestions and auto-complete
- Search results support multi-dimensional sorting and filtering

### API Endpoints

#### Get Project List from Explorer
```
GET /explore
Parameters:
- id: Category identifier (all/frontend/backend/mobile etc.)
- lang: Programming language filter
- license: License filter
- order: Sorting method (recommend/latest/stars)
- page: Page number
```

#### Category Filtering
```
GET /explore/:category
Parameters:
- category: Category name
```

#### Topic Projects
```
GET /explore/topic/:label
Parameters:
- label: Topic label
- license: License filter
- lang: Language filter
- order: Sorting method
```

### Use Cases

#### Developers
- **Technology Selection**: Find mature solutions in specific fields
- **Learning Reference**: Study code from excellent projects
- **Open Source Contribution**: Discover interesting projects to contribute to
- **Trend Tracking**: Understand technical trends and popular projects

#### Enterprise Users
- **Technical Research**: Evaluate the suitability of open source projects for enterprise use
- **Team Learning**: Provide learning resources for development teams
- **Project Promotion**: Showcase enterprise open source projects for more exposure
- **Talent Recruitment**: Identify excellent developers through their contributions

#### Educational Institutions
- **Teaching Resources**: Find open source projects suitable for teaching
- **Student Practice**: Recommend open source project participation opportunities
- **Research Reference**: Access open source tools for academic research

### Data Statistics

- **Project Coverage**: Covers millions of open source projects
- **Category System**: 20+ primary categories, 100+ secondary categories
- **Language Support**: Supports filtering by 50+ programming languages
- **Update Frequency**: Project data updated in real time, recommendation algorithm updated daily

### Related Features

- **Favorite Projects**: Users can bookmark projects of interest
- **Follow Authors**: Get update notifications by following project authors
- **Comments and Discussions**: Project pages support user comments and discussions
- **Sharing**: Supports social media sharing and link forwarding

## CLA

CLA, full name **Contributor License Agreement (贡献者许可协议)**, simply means that before a project receives a `Pull Request` from a contributor, the contributor needs to sign a contract. The contract needs to be signed only once, and it will take effect for all contributions from that contributor.

> Gitee has native support for managing, signing, and complying with the CLA protocol.
> This feature is currently open to "organizations" on Gitee. Organization administrators can manage CLA through `organization homepage` -> `settings` -> `CLA management`.

CLA is defined by the project owner, with some differences in detail, but generally includes the following:

- About the subject and contribution of signing the CLA;
- Granting copyright and patent licenses to companies or organizations that own the software intellectual property;
- The signer guarantees that they have the right to grant the above licenses;
- All contributions are copyrighted by the individual, or authorized by the copyright owner, and the contributor is not aware of any infringement caused by the contribution;
- A disclaimer of liability for contributions;
- Instructions on how to submit non-original works;
- Notifying the signatory of any inaccurate facts or circumstances.

> CLA is different from open source licenses, which have about 100 types, while CLA has thousands. Each project has its own CLA. However, these CLAs have some common points because most of them are derived from the CLA developed by the Apache Software Foundation. The terms are long and involve many legal terms, so it's difficult for most people to understand what these terms mean. If you want to understand them, you may need to spend time and money consulting a lawyer.

# What if I don't sign CLA?

Not signing CLA means that the contributor does not authorize, so if a company or organization wants to re-sign CLA, or change the open source license, or sue someone for infringement, then they must notify the contributor and get consent from them for all the things that require copyright.

For open source software with fewer contributors, this is easy; if it's a large and long-term project, this process may take a long time, because the company or organization may not just want a large number of contributors, but also their successors.

# Related Cases

In 2015, the LLVM community proposed to re-license the code, hoping to change from the existing NCSA license to Apache 2.0 License. Six years have passed, and this work is still ongoing. The LLVM community is tracking some past contributors to collect their recognition of the protocol change. Currently, more than 94% of the old code has been re-licensed, and it is expected that by 2023, it can approach 100%, at which point the license can be legally changed.

It sounds unbelievable, but there's nothing we can do about it, because everyone is doing it this way, and Mozilla also spent several years (2001-2006) re-licensing Firefox, Thunderbird, and related software.

## Gitee Issue Template Introduction

Gitee supports configuring templates for Issues to help set different types of Issue content for repositories, improving the efficiency and standardization of user feedback and suggestions.

## Directory and Configuration Structure

Gitee Issue templates support two forms:

- **Markdown Template**: Written in `.md` files, suitable for traditional text description.
- **Form Template**: Written in `.yml`/`.yaml` files, supporting form interaction, custom fields, default assignment, automatic labels, etc.

Template files need to be placed in the `.gitee/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` directory of the default branch. The example structure is as follows:

.gitee/
  ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
    feature.yml      # Feature suggestion form template
    bug.yml          # Bug feedback form template
    config.yml       # Template selector configuration (optional)
  issue_template.md  # Blank Issue template (optional)

> Note: Templates must be created in the default branch, file names are case-insensitive, and extensions are `.md`, `.yml`, or `.yaml`.

## Template Configuration Instructions

- **Markdown Template**: The file header needs to include YAML front matter, at least containing `name:` and `about:` fields.
- **YAML Form Template**: It needs to include `name:` and `description:` fields, and form content is defined through the `body:` field, supporting various form types (input, dropdown, single choice, multiple choice, code block, etc.).

### config.yml (Template Selector)

Add `config.yml` under `.gitee/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`, you can customize the list of Issue templates. For example:

blank_issues_enabled: false
contact_links:
  - name: Gitee Help Center
    url: https://help.gitee.com/
    about: Provides Git usage guides, tutorials, platform feature introductions, and answers to frequently asked questions

Field explanations:
- `blank_issues_enabled`: Whether to allow creating blank Issues, `false` means only templates can be used.
- `contact_links`: Users can be guided to access external documents or feedback channels.

## Issue Template Field Examples

name: Feature Suggestion
description: Make a feature suggestion for this project
title: "[Feature Suggestion]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees:
  - gitee
body:
  # Specific form item configuration, please refer to Gitee form style documentation

Field explanations:
- `name`: Template name, required
- `description`: Template description, required
- `title`: Issue title prefix, optional
- `labels`: Default labels, optional
- `assignees`: Default assigned users, optional
- `body`: Form content, required

## Blank Issue Template

If you want to support blank Issues, you can add Markdown content in `.gitee/issue_template.md` and enable blank Issues in `config.yml`.

## Compatibility Notes

Gitee Issue templates are compatible with GitHub Issue Template, supporting the following directory priority (from high to low):
1. `.gitee/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`
2. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`
3. `.gitee` repositories under the same space

## SonarQube Code Analysis

Gitee platform has built-in SonarQube code quality analysis service, which can scan code lines, duplicate rates, logical defects (such as null pointers), leaked passwords/keys, bad smells, etc., and generate detailed reports and repair suggestions.

> This service is currently only available to Enterprise Edition and recommended projects.

### How to Enable Code Quality Detection

1. Go to the project homepage, click "Services" -> "Code Quality Analysis".
2. Click "Start Analysis", fill in the analysis directory, branch, and language, and submit to start analysis.
3. After analysis is complete, you can directly view the detailed code quality report, and support filtering by problem type, severity, label, etc.

- [Enable Code Quality Detection](https://help.gitee.com/services/SonarQube#%E5%90%AF%E7%94%A8%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E8%B4%A8%E9%87%8F%E6%A3%80%E6%B5%8B)

## Squash Merge (Flattening Merge) Guide

Squash Merge (Flattening Merge) can be used when merging Pull Requests, compressing all commits into one, simplifying the submission history of the target branch, and avoiding redundant Merge commits. It's suitable for scenarios where you want to keep the branch history neat.

- When creating a Pull Request, you can select "Use Squash Merge" in the merge options.
- If the repository has disabled this merge method, the option will be disabled.
- You can set the default merge strategy in "Repository Settings-Function Settings".

- [Background](https://help.gitee.com/base/pullrequest/squash#%E8%83%8C%E6%99%AF)

## Fork + Pull Mode Guide

Gitee recommends using the "Fork + Pull" mode to participate in open source project development. The process is as follows:

1. **Fork Repository**: Click "fork" on the target repository page, select namespace, and complete repository derivation.
2. **Development and Submission**: Develop in your forked repository, submit Pull Request after differences are made.
3. **Submit Pull Request**: Fill in the description, submit for review by the original repository maintainer, and merge.
4. **Management and PR Modification**: PR information can be edited, assignee can be specified, and new submissions can be pushed automatically updating PR.
5. **Conflict Resolution**: If there is a merge conflict, you need to resolve it locally and push before PR status updates automatically.
6. **PR Rollback**: If accidentally merged, you can generate a reverse PR through rollback function to complete rollback.

- [Fork + Pull Mode Create PR](https://help.gitee.com/base/pullrequest/Fork+Pull#fork--pull-%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA-pull-request)

- [How to submit Pull Request](https://help.gitee.com/base/pullrequest/Fork+Pull#%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4-pull-request)
- [PR Management and Modification](https://help.gitee.com/base/pullrequest/Fork+Pull#%E5%AF%B9%E5%B7%B2%E7%BB%8F%E5%AD%98%E5%9C%A8%E7%9A%84-pull-request-%E7%9A%84%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86)
- [PR Conflict and Rollback](https://help.gitee.com/base/pullrequest/Fork+Pull#pull-request-%E4%B8%8D%E8%83%BD%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%90%88%E5%B9%B6%E8%AF%A5%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86)

- **Documentation Service**: [JavaDoc, PHPDoc automatic generation and hosting](https://help.gitee.com/services/apidocs)
- **Knowledge Management**: [Document creation, permission, editing, preview, sharing, searching, importing, exporting, attachment management, etc.](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/knowledge)
- **Code Management**: [Security, hosting, review, permission, integration, capacity, Git knowledge, etc.](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/code)

---

## Gitee AI Assistant

"Ma Jianchang's AI assistant" developed by Gitee is an intelligent tool integrated into the platform, aiming to improve software development and project management efficiency. The AI assistant can provide intelligent assistance for team members and individual developers in code review, daily programming, document generation, etc.

- [Activation Process](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/ai/start)
- [AI Assistant Function Introduction](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/ai/ai-intro)

---

## Gitee OpenAPI Guide

Gitee provides comprehensive OpenAPI support, allowing developers to automate repository, project, member, Issue, PR, etc. management through API, facilitating integration with third-party systems and customized development.

- [OpenAPI Documentation](https://help.gitee.com/openapi/v5)

---

## Gitee Code Scanning Guide

Gitee Enterprise Edition supports code scanning functionality, automatically detecting code defects and security issues, improving code quality and security. Supports multi-language, multi-rule sets, and scanning results can be integrated into PR quality gate and project reports.

- [Code Scanning Function Explanation](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/codescan)

---

## InnerSource (Internal Source) Introduction

InnerSource (Internal Source) is the best practice and culture of open source development within the enterprise, promoting collaboration and innovation. Even if proprietary software is developed, the development process is also open within the organization.

**Main Advantages:**
- Improve development efficiency and quality, reduce costs
- Break down departmental barriers, promote cross-team collaboration
- Promote code reuse and innovation
- Flexible allocation of development resources, improving employee积极性
- Enhance knowledge sharing and management

**Gitee Support for InnerSource:**
- Gitee Enterprise Edition has built-in "InnerSource" channel, centrally managing enterprise internal and external open source projects, aggregating community contributions and evaluations, helping enterprise open source governance.
- Reference: [Gitee Enterprise InnerSource Best Practices](https://gitee.com/InnerSource/gitee-innersource-best-practices)
- Immediate Experience: [Activate Gitee Enterprise Edition](https://gitee.com/enterprises/new?from=innersource)

**Extensive Reading and Materials:**
- [InnerSource Introduction PDF](https://gitee.com/InnerSource/definition_of_innersource/raw/master/getting-started-with-innersource.pdf)
- [InnerSource Practice PDF](https://gitee.com/InnerSource/definition_of_innersource/raw/master/AdoptingInnerSource.pdf)
- [PPT: Internal Open Source WHAT, WHY, HOW](https://gitee.com/OSCYuanChuangHui/2018_lecturer_ppt/raw/master/2019.12.15%20%E6%B7%B1%E5%9C%B3%E5%B9%B4%E7%BB%88%E7%9B%9B%E5%85%B8/%E5%BC%80%E6%BA%90%E6%B2%BB%E7%90%86/3.%20%E5%86%85%E9%83%A8%E5%BC%80%E6%BA%90%E7%9A%84%20WHAT%20:%20WHY%20:%20HOW%E2%80%94%E2%80%94%E8%B0%AD%E4%B8%AD%E6%84%8F.pdf)
- More articles available at the original link

---

## Gitee SSH Public Key Fingerprint

To ensure secure connection to Gitee.com code repositories, please verify the SSH public key fingerprint to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.

**Gitee Official Public Key Fingerprint:**
- ED25519: `SHA256:+ULzij2u99B9eWYFTw1Q4ErYG/aepHLbu96PAUCoV88`
- RSA: `SHA256:meTsVSCgOas8fBnJyx8EPlUJr6iQ96riFmCFPfUkDtU`
- ECDSA: `SHA256:FQGC9Kn/eye1W8icdBgrQp+KkGYoFgbVr17bmjey0Wc`

**Verification Command:**
```bash
ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/known_hosts | grep gitee.com
```
If the return value matches the official fingerprint, it means a secure connection.

- [Official Fingerprint Explanation](https://help.gitee.com/account/gitees-ssh-key-fingerprints#gitee-%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E9%92%A5%E6%8C%87%E7%BA%B9)
- [Verification Method](https://help.gitee.com/account/gitees-ssh-key-fingerprints#%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81-sha256-%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95%E6%8C%87%E7%BA%B9)

---

## Repository Statistics Overview

Gitee provides multi-dimensional repository statistics to help users understand project dynamics and data comprehensively:

- **Access Statistics**: View repository access volume, visitor sources, etc. [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/statistics/access)
- **Data Statistics**: Statistics on code volume, submission count, core data contributed by developers, etc. [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/statistics/stats)
- **Network Diagram**: Visualizes the repository network structure of branches, merges, forks, etc. [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/statistics/graph)

---

## Repository Member Management

- **Member Role Explanation**: Gitee supports various member permissions to meet different collaboration needs. [Role Explanation](https://help.gitee.com/repository/member/permission)
- **Add Member**: Add collaborators in "Management" - "Repository Settings" - "Repository Member Management". [Add Member](https://help.gitee.com/repository/member/add)
- **Remove Member**: Members can also be removed in the member management page, and after removal, they will lose repository permissions. [Remove Member](https://help.gitee.com/repository/member/delete)

---

## File Operation Guide

- **File Creation, Update, Deletion**: [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/file-operate/creation-update-and-deletion)
- **Rename, Move Files**: [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/file-operate/rename-and-move)
- **File Comparison**: Supports file content comparison between multiple submissions. [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/file-operate/compare)
- **History Versions and Submission History**: All history versions and change records of the file can be traced. [Operation Instructions](https://help.gitee.com/repository/file-operate/history)

---

## Project Management Product Introduction

Gitee project management covers the entire lifecycle of R&D, supporting waterfall, agile (Scrum, Kanban) development models, and seamless integration with code management, CI/CD, testing management, etc. Provides flexible customized configuration to meet the collaboration needs of different teams and scenarios, helping teams work efficiently.

- [Product Introduction](https://help.gitee.com/enterprise/project/intro)

---
